connector.name: Apexapi MCP
connector.registryDescription: Call 120+ AI models and live web context (scrape/crawl/extract) from any MCP client with one key
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package apexapi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the apexapi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: APEXAPI_API_KEY
env.description: Your ApexApi API key (starts with 'ak-'). Get one at https://apexapi.dev or via agent self-registration per https://apexapi.dev/auth.md
